name: model-router-omp
description: Routes Oh My Pi subagents to the smol or slow model role, judged by Jev. It sends the redacted task text and the agent's description to api.typesafe.ai, openrouter.ai or both, as its provider setting allows. The scope setting picks the agents: core routes the bundled task agent, extended routes every agent whose model you did not set. The plugin can store a key you type in its dialog.

provider.description: Which providers judge each task, in order. auto: TypeSafe, then OpenRouter. openrouter-first: OpenRouter, then TypeSafe.

scope.description: Which subagents are routed. core: the task agent only. extended: every agent whose model you did not set, bundled agents included.
